rows.definition: Checked per-layer convolution-history and recurrent-state element and payload byte dimensions for explicit Qwen state dtype before allocation.
rows.distinction: State payload dimensions only, not tensor element ordering, weight packing, allocator ownership, pool capacity, memory-fit admission, or device execution; host and HAL consumers explicitly retain F32.

rows.definition: Pure checked constructor of Qwen35StateLayout from model geometry and explicit state dtype, returning invalid-shape or arithmetic-overflow errors before allocation.
rows.distinction: Computes and validates a state payload plan; unlike Qwen35StateLayout, it is the fallible planning operation, not the resulting immutable dimension record. It does not allocate state or choose pool capacity.
